jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.description:
About Act 
 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 
 Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.
  
 About the Role 
 You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
 We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
  
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

 Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

 Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

 Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

 Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

 Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

 Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

  
 What You Will Need 
 Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

 Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

 Comfortable working across different business functions.

 Strong ownership and execution skills.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

  
 How We Work 
 The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.
 We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
 This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.
  
 Interview Process 
 If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.
 Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.
 We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.title: Product Analytics Manager, Travelers
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 Travelers come to GetYourGuide with options in front of them, and they book when they’re confident they’ve found the right one. As a member of the Traveler Analytics leadership team, you’ll lead Comparison Analytics. You’ll define how we measure and improve the moment travelers choose between experiences: the activity page, the content and reviews behind it, how options and prices are presented, and what makes one experience stand out from another.
 This means answering hard product questions. What makes a traveler confident enough to book? Which content changes decisions, and how do we measure that when conversion alone misses part of the value? How do price and value presentation shape choice? You’ll partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Content leaders to shape these decisions, while building the analytics foundation and the team that delivers the answers. We need someone who has built and led high-performing analytics teams, built the measurement a product area runs its decisions on, and shaped company strategy with data.
 Your toolkit 
 Proven leadership: You’ve hired, developed, and grown teams of analysts in fast-growth environments. You’ve coached analysts into senior ICs and leads, and you’re great at it.

 Strategic partnership: You’ve shaped company strategy and roadmaps, influenced resource allocation, and built measurement frameworks that change how businesses make decisions instead of only reporting on them.

 Hands-on technical fluency: You’re a hands-on leader who is proficient with SQL, experimentation design, causal inference, and metric definition. You can review a complex analysis, spot the flaw, and get into the data when needed. You don’t need to write every query, but you can, and you’ll use those skills to level up the team.

 Influence executives: You turn complex analyses into crisp recommendations. You know when to push back on ideas and when to say “we don’t know yet, but here’s how we’ll find out.

 Extras that give you an edge 
 Two-sided marketplace or e-commerce experience (preferred but not required)

 How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary 
 Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

 Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

 A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 

 Opportunities to collaborate and socialize  with a quarterly team event budget 

 Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them

 Monthly transportation and fitness budget

 Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

 Language reimbursement program

 Health and wellness benefits

 And more…

jobs.title: Project Manager, Merchandising
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 We're looking for a driven, analytical, outcome-focused Project Manager to join our Merchandising team. You'll take open-ended quality challenges on our supplier and traveler-facing data, think activity attributes, categories, and location data, and turn them into scoped, measurable projects, using AI to scale your work across our inventory. This is a data and process role: you'll be working with structured content and quality metrics, not copywriting or editorial content.
 Your mission 
 Own outcome-driven projects end-to-end: set the scope, timeline, and success metric upfront, then run execution independently (i.e., freelancer content batches, supplier data fixes, or full quality evaluation cycles)

 Define what "good" means for your domain: build and validate datasets, set precision and recall targets, and keep both current as new failure patterns surface.

 Build AI-powered quality checks: configure and orchestrate LLM-based workflows that replace manual review at scale.

 Partner with senior stakeholders to scope ambiguous problems, then own execution independently: prioritize by data-backed impact over ticket volume, close gaps before they turn into blockers, and present your solutions with clarity and conviction.

 Your toolkit 
 Experience owning projects end to end, from turning a fuzzy operational problem into a bounded project with a clear scope through to a delivered result

jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.
 Your mission 
 As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.
 The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.
 We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.

 Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.

 Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.

 Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.

 Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.

 Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.

 Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
 
 The Role 
 Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Gefragt ist eine pragmatische Persönlichkeit, die Lösungen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Aufgaben selbst anpackt.

 Verantwortung für die Pflege und Priorisierung des Product Backlogs im Bereich Corporate Actions

 Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklung klären und in umsetzbare Arbeitspakete übersetzen

 Pragmatische Lösungen erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung aktiv vorantreiben

 Inhaltlich und operativ mitarbeiten, Hindernisse erkennen und gemeinsam mit dem Team lösen

 Eng mit der Projektleitung zusammenarbeiten und die Umsetzung des laufenden Projekts unterstützen

 Den Neustart des Teams mitgestalten und eine kooperative, lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit fördern

 Fundierte Fachkenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Corporate Actions

 Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Entwickler, Business Analyst, Projektleiter oder Product Owner

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join our mission 
 We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 
 We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.
 After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.
 Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.
 
 About the role 
 As a Technical Project Manager at Namespace, you'll drive technical projects from planning through execution, working closely with engineering teams to translate business goals into clear technical work, manage timelines and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned. You'll bring a strong technical background and experience working with software engineering and developer tools, allowing you to understand technical trade-offs, anticipate risks, and operate effectively alongside engineers.
 
 Our culture 
 We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.
  
 What you'll do 
 Translate high-level business goals into clear technical tasks and project plans for engineering teams

 Create and maintain project documentation, managing timelines, budgets, scope, resources, and day-to-day priorities

 Anticipate technical obstacles, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure appropriate testing and quality standards

 Keep engineering teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and company leadership aligned on progress, priorities, and roadblocks

 Manage technical vendors and suppliers as part of project delivery

 
 What we're looking for 
 Technical background with experience in software development, engineering, computer science, or a closely related field

 Proven experience managing technical projects, either in a dedicated technical project management role or as a significant part of an engineering or technical role

 Experience working closely with software engineering teams and a strong understanding of how engineering projects are planned, built, and shipped

 Familiarity with developer tools and modern software development workflows

 Ability to understand technical requirements, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks and translate them into clear project plans

 Strong ownership and ability to drive multiple stakeholders toward execution in a fast-moving environment

 
 You can expect: 
 Competitive salary and stock options

 Flexible working hours

 Market-leading parental leave

 
 Life at Namespace Labs:

 The Opportunity

Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team in London or Munich with a hybrid work setup . In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of our Gift Cards vertical; one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning provider integrations, checkout and redemption flows, and multi-market expansion across France, Germany, and Spain. 

 You will lead commercial relationships with key gift card providers, define the product roadmap, and partner with engineering and design to scale gift cards into an integrated core offering across web, app, and browser extensions .

 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will:

 
 Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

 Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

 Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

 Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

 Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

 Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a tech company and/or a startup.

 A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

 Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

 Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

jobs.title: Product Manager Soft Fabrics
jobs.description:
Hunter Douglas is wereldwijd marktleider in raamdecoratie en een toonaangevende producent van architecturale producten. Wij zijn een merk dat u kent en vertrouwt. Met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie hebben wij onze industrie mede vormgegeven met unieke producten die baanbrekend design en functionaliteit combineren. Onze producten zijn wereldwijd te vinden in miljoenen woningen en commerciële gebouwen. Wij zijn op zoek naar gedreven, intelligente, creatieve en ondernemende mensen. Door uitdagende functies en versnelde groeimogelijkheden te bieden, gedreven door een gezamenlijke ambitie om succesvol te zijn, creëren wij een omgeving waarin uw carrière zich verder kan ontwikkelen.

In ruil voor uw expertise bieden wij een competitief en uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, zodat u zich gewaardeerd voelt voor de bijdrage die u levert. Onze ambitie is om het snelst groeiende en meest geliefde raamdecoratiebedrijf ter wereld te worden. Wat is uw ambitie?

Product Manager Soft Fabrics

 

Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige stoffen die hun weg vinden naar klanten door heel Europa? Krijg je energie van de combinatie van productontwikkeling, commercie en projectmanagement? Dan is dit een mooie kans om als Product Manager Soft Fabrics onderdeel te worden van ons Product Team.

 

Jouw rol

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het product en het commerciële succes van onze collecties voor gordijn- en meubelstoffen. Design is verantwoordelijk voor de creatieve ontwikkeling van de stoffen. Vanuit Product Management vertegenwoordig jij de markt-, klant- en businessbehoefte. Je brengt markt- en klantinzichten in en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten. Vervolgens bewaak je samen met Design het ontwikkelproces en stuur je op een succesvolle productintroductie en optimale productlevenscyclus. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain en het Design Team.

 

Je combineert projectmanagement met commercieel inzicht, data-analyse en een passie voor textiel. Een veelzijdige rol waarin je veel verschillende mensen en disciplines bij elkaar brengt.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus, van concept tot uitfasering.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je coördineert productontwikkelingsprojecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie, waarbij je samenwerkt met Design voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's, budget en afstemming tussen de verschillende betrokken teams.
  • Je bent gedurende het ontwikkelproces een commerciële en strategische sparringpartner voor Design.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je ondersteunt bij prijsstelling, productpositionering en businesscases.
  • Je werkt samen met Sales en Marketing aan productintroducties, trainingen en commerciële tools.
  • Je zorgt voor goede productinformatie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe stakeholders.

 

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een junior/medior professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en projecten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.

 

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.
  • Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.

 

Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.

Jouw rol

Van het eerste idee tot de introductie in de markt en uiteindelijk de doorontwikkeling of uitfasering: jij houdt het overzicht en zorgt dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment in beweging komen.

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere Design, Sales, Marketing, R&D, Procurement, Operations en Manufacturing. Je vertaalt markt- en klantinzichten naar concrete productoplossingen en zorgt dat nieuwe collecties succesvol hun weg vinden naar de Europese markt.

 

Een veelzijdige rol dus, waarin productmanagement, projectmanagement, commercieel inzicht en data-analyse samenkomen.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio, daarbij zorg je voor correcte productspecificaties, productdata en documentatie gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus.
  • Je leidt productontwikkelingsprojecten van concept tot marktintroductie.
  • Je brengt verschillende disciplines en stakeholders bij elkaar en bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's en resultaten.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je werkt mee aan productpositionering, prijsbeslissingen en businesscases.
  • Je ondersteunt Sales en Marketing met producttrainingen, presentaties en marktintroducties.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe collecties.
  • Je fungeert als productexpert voor interne en externe stakeholders en vertaalt complexe productinformatie naar duidelijke adviezen en oplossingen.
  • Je zorgt samen met Supply Chain en Operations voor een soepele introductie van nieuwe producten en een betrouwbare productbeschikbaarheid.

Je bent een ervaren en zelfstandige professional die graag structuur brengt in complexe projecten en energie krijgt van samenwerken met verschillende disciplines.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte blik.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het werken aan meerdere projecten en met verschillende stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Duits of een andere extra taal is een pré.
  • Interesse in AI en de manier waarop AI kan bijdragen aan productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

 So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

 
 Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries .

 What we build 

 
 
 
 
 Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.

 
 Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.

 
 Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.

 
 Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.

 

 
 Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.

 

 The 5 values we work by 

 
 
 
 
 Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.

 
 Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.

 
 Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.

 
 Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.

 
 No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.

 

 
 We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.
 

 
 Context 📄

 How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

 As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

 Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

 Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

 Key responsibilities 🚀

 1) Build market and customer understanding 

 
 
 Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions.

 
 Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority.

 
 Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio.

 
 2) Define positioning and support commercial teams 

 
 
 Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams.

 
 Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products.

 
 Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials.

 
 3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions 

 
 
 Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

 
 Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents.

 
 Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

 

 About you 👇

 
 
 You have at least 5 years of experience

jobs.description:
Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais) 
 Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
 Niveau : Senior Product Manager
 Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM)
 Contrat : CDI
 À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. 
 Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza 
 Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.
 Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.
 Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.
 Ce que vous ferez : 
 Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.
 Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

 Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

 Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

 Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

 Ce que vous apportez : 
 Critères essentiels :
 Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

 Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

 De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

 Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

 Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité tec

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 The opportunity 
 Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.
 As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.
 You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.
 What you’ll do 
 Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

 Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

 Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

 Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

 Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

 Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

 Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

 Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

 What you bring 
 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

 Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

 A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

 Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

 The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

 Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

 Fluent English.

 Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

 Why BLP 
 Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

 Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

 A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

 Employee participation plan.

 How we work 
 Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

 Transparency: We build trust through openness.

 Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

 Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

 Practical information 
 Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

 Employment: full-time, permanent.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Financial Services (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Omnium ist die hybride Finanzberatungsplattform von G+D Netcetera für Schweizer Banken und Versicherungen. Die Lösung verbindet persönliche Beratung mit digitalen Werkzeugen und unterstützt Finanzinstitute dabei, ihre Kund:innen über alle Kanäle hinweg konsistent zu begleiten. So entstehen moderne Beratungserlebnisse und effiziente Prozesse für unsere Kunden.
 Für unseren Bereich Financial Advisory suchen wir eine erfahrene Projektmanagement-Persönlichkeit, die anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungsprojekte rund um Omnium von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss steuert. Du verbindest Kund:innenbedürfnisse, fachliche Anforderungen und technische Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen verlässlich, transparent und mit nachhaltigem Mehrwert realisiert werden.
 Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kund:innen, dem Produktmanagement, der Produktentwicklung und der technischen Integration zusammen. Du schaffst Klarheit über Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Abhängigkeiten und führst interdisziplinäre Teams sicher durch alle Projektphasen.
 Requirements 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du planst und realisierst Projekte zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Omnichannel-Beratungslösung Omnium und integrierst diese in die Systemlandschaften unserer Kund:innen
 Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für Qualität, Liefertermine, Ressourcen und Kosten
 Du berichtest transparent über Projektfortschritt und Risiken und leitest frühzeitig geeignete Massnahmen ein
 Du konzipierst und moderierst fachliche sowie technische Workshops
 Du führst interdisziplinäre Projektteams mit agilen oder hybriden Projektmanagement-Methoden
 Du koordinierst Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und technische Integration von der Konzeption bis zum offiziellen Projektabschluss
 Du stellst die strukturierte Übergabe in den Betrieb sicher und begleitest den Kunden auch nach der Einführung. Sei es im Ticketing, Releases und in der Zusammenarbeit mit der IT-Betriebsorganisation

 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Software- oder Digitalisierungsprojekte, idealerweise bei Banken, Versicherungen oder anderen regulierten Finanzinstituten
 Du fühlst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT, Produktentwicklung und Delivery im Kundenumfeld sicher
 Du beherrschst Projektgovernance, Budget- und Ressourcenplanung sowie Risiko- und Stakeholdermanagement
 Du arbeitest routiniert mit agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensmodellen sowie Jira und Confluence
 Du verfügst über eine höhere Fachausbildung oder ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Du überzeugst mit planerischem und lösungsorientiertem Denken, einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise, sicherem Auftreten sowie sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen. Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
 Was dich bei uns erwartet 
 Du triffst auf ein Umfeld, in dem Expertise in Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und Beratung zusammenkommt. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, unkompliziert und auf Augenhöhe, mit unseren Kund:innen genauso wie innerhalb des Teams. Eigeninitiative und unternehmerisches Denken sind bei uns ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wissen wird geteilt und gemeinsam suchen wir nach der besten Lösung.

Mit deiner Projektführung prägst du nicht nur die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kund:innen, sondern auch unsere Delivery-Prozesse und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Projektmanagement-Standards.
 Wenn du komplexe Vorhaben gerne strukturierst, Menschen und Themen zusammenbringst und Projekte mit klarem Blick für Kundennutzen und Umsetzungserfolg zum Ziel führst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
 Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
 About Us
 Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
 Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.
 The Role
 You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.
 Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
 We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.
 What You'll Do
 Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
 Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
 Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
 Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
 Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
 Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
 Hiring Process
 Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
 15-minute phone screen
 First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
 Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
 Culture fit (45 min)
 We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.
 Requirements 
 You Should Have
 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
 Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
 An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
 You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
 Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.

jobs.title: Product Support & Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 About the role 
 We are looking for a Product Support & Enablement Lead to lead and develop our existing L1 Product Support team. You will help the team resolve more customer issues without escalating to L2, while improving the tools, training, and workflows that allow support to scale.
 This is a senior technical and people-management role—not simply a role overseeing today’s queue. You will lead frontline delivery for Product Support (L1) and develop the team’s ability to investigate and resolve increasingly technical requests, including paid self-serve and first-level enterprise issues.
 You will work closely with L2 and other teams to define clear ownership, identify work Product Support (L1) can safely take on, and build repeatable escalation paths. You will also contribute to operational continuity for the wider Support organization.
 You will be equally comfortable coaching a team member through a customer issue, investigating an API error, improving a support workflow, and partnering with Engineering or Product to address a recurring problem.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Lead frontline support delivery 
 Lead, coach, and develop a distributed L1 Product Support team, providing regular feedback and supporting technical growth.

 Own day-to-day L1 Product Support delivery, including queue prioritization, backlog management, customer communication, and regional handoffs.

 Define and maintain clear ownership of L1 Product Support queues and handoffs to L2, including for paid self-serve and first-level enterprise requests.

 Monitor service quality, response and resolution times, backlog health, and customer satisfaction; turn insights into practical improvements.

 Stay hands-on with complex or sensitive customer issues and model strong technical judgment.

 
 Increase Product Support (L1) technical autonomy 
 Train and coach Product Support (L1) agents to investigate, reproduce, and resolve more technical issues across Mistral products, including Vibe, Studio, and APIs.

 Work with L2 to identify issue types that Product Support (L1) can safely take on and define the knowledge, access, and safeguards needed.

 Create playbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation criteria that help Product Support (L1) agents resolve issues independently and consistently.

 Improve L1-to-L2 handoffs so escalations contain customer impact, investigation steps, and relevant evidence.

 Track escalation patterns and use them to prioritize training, documentation, and product improvements.

 Scale systems, workflows, and automation 
 Own improvements to frontline support tooling, routing, workflows, macros, and internal processes.

 Own improvements to frontline Product Support (L1) tooling, routing, workflows, macros, and internal processes.

 Develop AI-assisted support and automation, including Intercom Fin, to reduce repetitive work while maintaining response quality and appropriate human escalation.

 Identify recurring contact drivers and partner with Product, Engineering, and other teams to address them at the source.

 Build reporting and operating reviews that make workload, service performance, escalation patterns, and risks visible.

 Establish shared processes with specialist Support teams while respecting their ownership of technical delivery.

 Build knowledge and operational continuity 
 Develop onboarding materials and technical training that help agents become autonomous.

 Work with Documentation and Product teams to keep internal guidance and customer-facing help content accurate and useful.

 Share customer insights and support trends with Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams.

 Help coordinate support readiness for new products, features, and processes.

 Contribute to operational continuity for the Support organization through team coordination, reporting, and escalation management.

 
 What we’re looking for

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

 Deep in the wording. Fast in the build. 

 About Insify 

 Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

 We're doing it differently.

 Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

 We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

 Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

 What you’ll own in your first year 
 You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

 
 Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.

 Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.

 Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.

 Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.

 Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

 
 Who you are 
 You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

 You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.

 You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be . Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.

 You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market , and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.

 You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.

 You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.

 You think like the customer : plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.

 You’re at home in Excel and data , and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.

 You work fluently in English ; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

 What we offer 

 Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.

 Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.

 A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.

 A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.

 Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.

 The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).

 The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

 If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

 Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

 Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

 Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

 Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

 Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

 Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

 Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

 
 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

 Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

 Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

 A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

 A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

 Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

 
 You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ 
 Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information,
