jobs.title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 

 Aufgaben

 
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.

 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.

 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.

 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.

 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.

 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.

 Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.

 Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen fachlichen und technischen Umfeldern und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Geschäftsprozesse ein.

 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung mit und vermittelst souverän zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, verstehst Nutzerbedürfnisse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und entwickelst auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen tragfähige Lösungen.

 Du hast Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie idealerweise mit Jira und Confluence.

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau).

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten

 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten

 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander

 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents

 Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung

 Mehr Work-Life-Balance durch eine Kooperation mit unserem Partner voiio

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
  • Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
  • Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
  • Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
  • Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explo

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

WHO WE ARE

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions.

You are:

  • Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs.
  • An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies.
  • Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management
  • Assist in defining, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on user needs, business goals, and data analysis.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Data Scientists, and UX Designers to ensure a shared understanding of product features and their underlying data implications.
  • Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.

 

Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation

  • Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements.
  • Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch.

jobs.description:
Ready to design products and services that make a difference?

 Do you want to create products that make a meaningful impact? Are you ready to lead strategy and delivery on projects that reach large audiences?

 

 If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Product Manager, you’ll lead product strategy and delivery, balancing user needs and business goals across sectors, to create services that are used by millions of UK citizens.

 

 The role 

 You’ll work with technical teams and stakeholders to develop solutions that deliver our clients’ strategic goals. You'll work in agile teams alongside people in a range of roles spanning design, development, and research.

 

 You’ll help deliver the vision, helping to decide the features that each product needs and manage backlogs to meet our client preferences. You'll deliver discovery and ideation workshops across diverse groups of stakeholders.

 

 Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.

 This role involves weekly on-site working. Applicants should be able to travel, as part of their daily commute, to client sites in one of the following locations: Newcastle, Leeds or Manchester.

 SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

 

 If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

You will have in-depth knowledge of software development, with experience in agile and user-centred design.

 
In your CV and the interview, you should show how you have:

 Contribute to improving ways of working and driving continuous improvements within your teams.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI automates customer service through lifelike voice assistants that let customers lead a conversation. Our voice assistants make it possible for businesses to deliver outstanding customer service that rivals their human agents.

Our customers, which include the world’s leading logos, are expanding how they use our platform, driving automation of critical customer service operations and integrating PolyAI into their daily customer service workflows.

We’re looking for a highly technical, senior product leader to own the platform underneath everything our agents do: the runtime that serves conversations in production, the inference layer that powers our models, and the data infrastructure that feeds both. This is a deep infrastructure role with direct exposure to latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs at scale, not a roadmap-and-backlog role. You’ll set strategy for areas other teams build on top of, working closely with engineering leadership rather than through them

  • Translate ambiguous technical constraints (capacity limits, model failure modes, data gaps) into decisions the rest of the business can plan around

Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

 

The Role 

Joining the Consumer Platforms team, you’ll help make Rightmove fast, consistent and easy to build on, so that our consumer product teams can ship great experiences with confidence. The team owns the shared foundations behind our website and apps: SEO and AI discoverability, site performance and accessibility, the design system, cross-team technical standards, client storage and analytics and tracking, and the third-party tooling that powers experimentation and CRM. 

Your customers are mostly internal: Product Managers, Engineers, Security, and Data and Analytics colleagues. You’ll learn where they struggle, turn that into a clear roadmap, and prove the impact in terms of both team productivity and outcomes. 

You’ll work day to day with the team’s Engineering Manager, Principal Engineers and Technical Architects. You’ll need to be as comfortable debating implementation detail with them as you are shaping priorities with product leaders. 

What you’ll own 

Our platform covers a lot of ground. Your main focus will be: 

  • Search and AI discoverability: establishing the framework that gives product teams clear visibility of how SEO and AI search (GEO) are performing, so they can act on it earlier. You’ll be the central point of contact for our dedicated SEO agency, and you’ll know enough about SEO and GEO to represent them well and help teams make good decisions 
  • Shared foundations: the design system, accessibility, and technical standards that product teams build to 
  • Data and tooling: analytics and tracking, client storage, and third-party tools such as our experimentation and CRM platforms, including how well they perform, what they cost and how they’re used

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 
 Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄  
 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.
 Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.
 We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.
 
 Introducing the Trainline Core Experience Team 👋 
The Core Experience team looks after how our customers find and book rail travel across the UK and Europe. Our work covers search, supply from carriers and the booking experience, all in service of our purpose of empowering greener travel choices and connecting people and places. We are a collaborative group who enjoy learning from our customers and from each other.

This is a brand new role, created to own what happens once a customer has found the right journey and moves towards booking: reservation details, optional extras and payment. Because it sits so close to the point of purchase, it offers a direct line to customer experience and revenue, and plenty of room to grow. You will work alongside our Search team and the Supply and Payments platform teams, with colleagues in commercial, design, data and engineering, to make booking simple and reliable for customers in every market we serve.

 In this role as the Product Manager, Booking Conversion, you will...🚄 
 Own the customer experience from the moment someone chooses a journey to a confirmed booking, setting clear goals for conversion (the share of customers who complete their booking) and revenue while enabling other teams with a stake in the journey.

 Run quick cycles of experimentation by forming hypotheses, testing ideas, learning from the results and iterating, while shaping a longer-term vision and roadmap for the booking journey.

 Use customer insight and data to understand where people hesitate or leave, and decide where to invest limited team capacity across each step of the journey.

 Build a deep understanding of how rail works in different markets and with different carriers. Decide when a market or carrier specific improvement is the right investment, and when to bring ideas and learnings together across markets so that value grows for customers everywhere, rather than staying in one place.

 Balance wider business goals from other teams, such as adding new supply, increasing booking features for each carrier, and introducing optional extras and new revenue streams, against keeping the journey simple and low in friction for customers.

 Partner closely with the Supply, Search, New Business, and Payments platform teams, alongside design, data and engineering, to align priorities and deliver improvements together.

 Communicate openly with a wide range of stakeholders, including commercial colleagues, explaining the reasoning behind decisions and sharing progress and results in a way that builds trust.

 Bring AI tools into your everyday work, such as prototyping, analysis and delivery, and help the team grow in confidence using them.

 
 We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 
 Experience improving conversion in a digital booking, checkout or purchase journey, using data to spot opportunities and measure the impact of your changes.

 Hands-on experience designing and running experiments, and turning what you learn into the next set of improvements.

 A customer-first mindset, with the ability to combine customer insight and data to make confident decisions even when information is incomplete.

 Confidence setting direction for a product area, balancing near-term improvements with a longer-term vision.

 Clear, thoughtful communication, with the ability to explain complex trade-offs and build alignment between teams who may have different priorities.

 Comfort weighing limited capacity against competing demands, and explaining what you will focus on and why.

 Ideally, experience balancing local needs with a wider shared strategy, for example across several markets or with third-party suppliers. It is also helpful if you are familiar with travel, ticketing or payments.

 You may also be curious about AI tools and keen to use them to prototype ideas, analyse results and speed up delivery.

We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

The Role

CreateFuture are looking for a collaborative and pragmatic Lead Product Manager to join our growing team and help us define and develop an exciting array of products over a variety of industries, technologies and domains.

Our Product Managers are responsible for working with senior leadership, our internal design and engineering teams and our clients to help define and implement product strategies that are consistent with our clients’ vision. This can be from early stage research and market analysis through to development, delivery and iteration.

As we rapidly scale, we’ve identified an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to help support our growth. 

This person will be responsible for shaping and leading client engagements. We have a variety of clients across many industries all of whom look to us to provide leadership and guidance.  

You will rapidly gain their trust and guide them toward a valuable customer focused outcome. To do this you’ll use your deep understanding of product management methodologies and a consistent application of good practice. 

You will also be responsible for the wellbeing of a team of product managers. You will help embed good practice and coach your team in client management techniques and the application of product management. 

Does this sound like you? Do you have experience in developing Product Managers and a passion for the craft of Product Management? Do you have an empathetic leadership style with a focus on coaching each person to help grow their career and skills? If so, we’ve got a great role for you to stretch your wings and see what you’re really capable of.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Reporting into the Head of Product Operations and be able to represent the team as we grow
  • Leading a team of Product Managers and support recruitment 
  • Helping embed and support career progression pathways using our development framework for personal growth
  • Providing support to the team through mentorship and coaching
  • Acting as an escalation point for the team, helping to remove internal and external blockers as needed
  • Supporting resourcing of Product Managers on projects
  • Identifying training and development needs
  • Lead clients through their digital transformation journey, ensuring long term lasting relationships are made with key decision-makers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Team
jobs.description:
About us 
 Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.
 Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.
 
 About the role 
 As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service.
 
 What you’ll do: 
 Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product.

 Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions.

 Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day.

 Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly.

 Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call.

 Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on.

 
 What you'll need: 
 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches.

 You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams.

 Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits.

 A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products.

 You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes.

 This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team.
 People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .
 
 Benefits: 
 Generous start-up equity

 Competitive Salary

 Lunch provided in the office

 Team building events

 Unlimited time off

 
 What is Restaurant Software? 
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.
 From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.
 How We Use AI at Tebi 
We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
 At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.
 En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 
 
 ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons 
 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
About Zego 🚀 
 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

 We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖
 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

 Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor .

 
 If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. 
 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Platform team. Platform powers every customer journey at Zego: the core services behind quoting, buying, paying for, changing, renewing and cancelling a policy.
 You’ll own a product domain within Platform, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping refine the longer-term platform strategy as we rebuild and modernise some of Zego’s most critical services. You’ll turn technical challenges into business value, and make sure your services are resilient, compliant and ready to be used by AI agents as well as our apps.
 
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals , and help refine the longer-term plans for Platform, balancing new capability, legacy rebuilds and reliability.

 Lead complex discovery autonomously as we modernise the policy lifecycle, moving capability off legacy systems one safe slice at a time.

 Dive deep into technical detail , understanding dependencies and failure modes, and making informed trade-offs with engineering.

 Treat internal teams as your customers , so launching a new product, price or journey on the platform is fast and predictable.

 Make your services AI-ready , with clean, well-documented APIs and data that agents and automations can use safely, and establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain.

 Put the right metrics in place , from reliability and incidents to time-to-launch and cost to serve, and build the business case for platform investment.

 Build compliance in from day one with Legal, Compliance and Finance, so money flows and customer communications are accurate and auditable.

 Bring stakeholders along , running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

 
 What You’ll Need to Be Successful 
 Platform product ownership. A track record of owning a technical, platform or backend product domain and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

 Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on system architecture, APIs, event-driven services and workflow orchestration. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

 Legacy modernisation. You’ve led incremental rebuilds of business-critical services while keeping the lights on.

 Data and commercial fluency. You use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground decisions, query Snowflake or Looker yourself, and can build the case for platform investment.

 Clarity in complexity. You untangle dependencies across multiple business domains and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

 Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, payments, lending or financial services, with compliance built into product design.

 You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

 
 The Zego ways of working 🏡 
 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.
 We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.
 Here is what the last one looked like .
 
 Benefits 🎁 
 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.
 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.
 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

 Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, even when changes touch price and live policies.

 Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team’s output, from trip-data analysis to automated data and model monitoring.

 Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

 
 What You’ll Need to Be Successful 
 Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.

 Data, sensor or ML products. You’ve built products on behavioural, location or sensor data - ideally telematics, mobility or IoT - and understand how signals become models, and models become decisions.

 Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on mobile SDKs, data pipelines and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.

 Commercial and risk fluency. Deep understanding of pricing levers, risk modelling and loss ratios, and credible with Actuarial, Finance and Leadership.

 Data mastery. You are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review, and you can interrogate model performance, not just read a dashboard.

 Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests.

 You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
 Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
 About Us
 Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
 Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.
 The Role
 You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.
 Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
 We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.
 What You'll Do
 Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
 Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
 Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
 Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
 Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
 Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
 Hiring Process
 Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
 15-minute phone screen
 First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
 Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
 Culture fit (45 min)
 We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.
 Requirements 
 You Should Have
 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
 Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
 An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
 You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
 Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Energiewirtschaft steckt mitten in der größten Transition ihrer Geschichte. Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter brauchen Software, die da mithält, und sie brauchen jemanden, der ihnen klar und glaubwürdig erklärt, warum epilot genau die richtige Plattform ist.
 Als Senior Product Marketing Manager bist du genau diese Stimme im Markt. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir epilot als zentrale, AI-native Plattform für die neue Energiewelt positionieren. Und du sorgst dafür, dass Marketing, Sales und Customer Success eine gemeinsame Geschichte erzählen.
 Product Marketing ist für dich das Fundament jeder Kommunikation und nicht nur der Lieferant für Slides und Battle Cards? Dann lies weiter.
 epilot ist das XRM für die Energiewirtschaft: Unsere Plattform verbindet nicht nur Kund:innen, sondern auch Partner, Installateure, Lieferanten und interne Teams. Über 200 Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber arbeiten bereits damit, und unser Team aus über 120 Menschen wächst weiter. Wenn du Teil dieser Journey sein und epilot an entscheidender Stelle voranbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Positionierung und Messaging der epilot Plattform liegen in deiner Verantwortung, für Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter. Produktfunktionen übersetzt du in Mehrwerte, die bei allen wichtigen Personas ankommen.

 Nah am Markt: In Sales-Calls, im Gespräch mit Kund:innen und auf Branchenevents erfährst du, was Energieversorger gerade umtreibt. Daraus hältst du ICPs, Personas und Wettbewerbsanalysen aktuell und machst sie zu Wissen, mit dem das ganze Unternehmen arbeitet.

 Produktkampagnen und Markteinführungen steuerst du inhaltlich, von der Story bis zu den Kernbotschaften, gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign & Growth Marketing. Auch die inhaltliche Qualität unserer Produktseiten und weitere produktnahe Inhalte liegt in deiner Verantwortung.

 Sales und Customer Success machst du sprechfähig: mit Pitch-Materialien, Argumentationshilfen, Einwandbehandlung und Trainings.

 AI-gestützte Workflows für Product Marketing baust du auf und entwickelst sie weiter, etwa für Persona- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Messaging oder Sales-Materialien. AI ist für dich kein Knopfdruck: Die Logik dahinter entwickelst du selbst.

 Unsere Junior Product Marketing Managerin führst du fachlich und begleitest sie in ihrer Entwicklung.

 Strategy, Produktmanagement, Sales, Customer Success, Campaign & Growth sowie Event Marketing schätzen dich als Sparringspartner:in. 

 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing , idealerweise im Product Marketing. Positionierung und Messaging hast du schon selbst verantwortet.

 Komplexe Produkte verstehst du schnell und erklärst sie einfach. Dabei findest du die Worte, bei denen Zielgruppen nicken, und nicht die, die nur intern gut klingen.

 Strategisch denken und selbst anpacken gehören für dich zusammen. Ein Messaging-Framework entwickelst du ebenso gern wie eine Produktseite oder einen Sales-Pitch. Auf ein Briefing wartest du nicht: Wo es eine klare Story braucht, bringst du sie auf den Weg.

 AI-Tools nutzt du nicht nur. Am liebsten baust du eigene Workflows, statt dich auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen.

 Neugier auf die Energiewirtschaft ist entscheidend. Branchenerfahrung oder Wissen über Energieprozesse ist ein großes Plus, wichtiger ist aber deine Lust, tief einzutauchen.

 Überzeugungskraft: Stakeholder bis hin zum C-Level gewinnst du mit klaren Argumenten. Außerdem macht es dir Freude, andere fachlich zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln.

 Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch auf C2-Niveau ist ein Muss, denn dein Messaging muss im deutschen Markt sitzen. Dazu sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Unternehmenssprache.

 
 Das bieten wir dir 
 Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote arbeiten, wann immer es passt, und regelmäßig in Köln zusammenkommen, wenn persönlicher Austausch zählt.

 Die Möglichkeit, die erfolgreichste SaaS-Plattform auf dem Energiemarkt mit aufzubauen.

 Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

 Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

 Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

 Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

 Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

 Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

 Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, ein Gym um die Ecke u.v.m.

 
Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen 💙 promise.epilot.cloud/

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Sidetrade 
 Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
 We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 
 Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion : Aimie Video 
 
 The role 
 As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.
 You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Requirements 
 
 What you will do: 
 Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
 Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
 Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
 Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
 Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
 Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
 Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
 Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
 Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
 Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.
 
 What you will bring: 
 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
 A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
 Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
 Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
 The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
 The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
 Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
 Willingness to travel up to 50%.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.
 
 Why Sidetrade 
 AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
 Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
 Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Benefits 
 Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days 
 Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
 Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs 
 Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays 
 Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support 
 
 Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 
 We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.
 If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 
 Agencies 
 We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

jobs.title: CDI - Manager Product Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

 

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Nabla 
 Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:
 Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.
 AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.
 Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.
 Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.
 About the Role
 The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.
 This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.
 You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.
 Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.
 This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.
 Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.
 Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:
 Self-serve clinicians , who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

 Mid-market and enterprise health systems , managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

 You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.
 
 Responsibilities
 Feature Launch Positioning & Activation 
 Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

 Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

 Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

 Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

 Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

 Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

 Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

 Lifecycle Strategy and Execution 
 Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

 Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:
 For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

 For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

 
 Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

 Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

 Experimentation and Analytics 
 Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

 Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

 Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

 Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

 Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

 Ensure all programs are developed and execu

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.
 Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.
 You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

 Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

 Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

 Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

 Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

 Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

 Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

 Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

 
 About You 
 Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

 Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

 Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

 Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

 Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

 Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

 Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

 Clear writing: sp

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus 
 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

 A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

 As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
 Note 
 We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 
 

 We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
 

 Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.

 Responsibilities 
 

 
 Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do.

 
 Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next.

 
 Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust.

 
 Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering.

 
 Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle.

 
 Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team.

 Requirements 
 

 
 You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them.

 
 You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business.
You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree.

 
 You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt.

 
 You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results.

 
 You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field.

 
 You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares.

 
 You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe.

 Plus 
 

 
 You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers.

 
 You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market.

 If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.
