jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.description:
About Act 
 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 
 Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.
  
 About the Role 
 You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
 We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
  
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

 Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

 Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

 Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

 Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

 Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

 Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

  
 What You Will Need 
 Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

 Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

 Comfortable working across different business functions.

 Strong ownership and execution skills.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

  
 How We Work 
 The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.
 We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
 This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.
  
 Interview Process

 Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.
 We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
  
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
  
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
  
 This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. 
  

 What you'll need 
 Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
  

 Outcomes 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap 

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch 

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds 

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted 

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP Enterprise Technology provides Technology services for WPP, the world’s largest communications services group. As a creative transformation company, WPP is helping its clients transform the future through extraordinary work. WPP ET is an integral part of that journey, and we are proud to provide technology for some of the world’s most creative brands.

Own WPP’s office-technology product set (meeting rooms, room booking, print, signage and building-access technology), retaining WPP control of standards and roadmap while Kyndryl delivers operations.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the roadmap, standards and backlog for meeting rooms, room booking, print and signage.
  • Drive a consistent, reliable and modern in-office technology experience.
  • Govern Kyndryl and AV/vendor operations and approve change.
  • Manage hardware standards, lifecycle and refresh.
  • Partner with facilities and agencies on room and workplace technology.
  • Prioritise demand and continuous improvement.
  • Define the service outcomes, standards and SLAs that Kyndryl and other partners deliver against.
  • Govern Kyndryl performance, manage demand and escalations, and retain WPP accountability for the service.
  • Own the service roadmap and approve partner-delivered change before it reaches production.

 

What you'll need:

  • Product / service ownership for meeting-room and office technology.
  • Microsoft Teams Rooms, AV, signage, print and room-booking platforms.
  • Hardware lifecycle and standards management.
  • Vendor governance and SLA management.
  • Backlog and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrable product or service ownership experience for the relevant technology.
  • Experience governing third-party / managed-service delivery against SLAs.
  • Relevant certifications and/or degree, or equivalent experience.
  • Owns the product/service vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog.
  • Balances user experience, security, cost and operational stability in every decision.
  • Holds delivery partners to account against agreed outcomes and SLAs.
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

As the Product Manager for Robotic Picking (OGRP), you will own Ocado’s flagship automated picking capability, which has completed over 350 million picks in production to date. Sitting within our Outbound Product Area, you will operate at the intersection of software, robotics and physical operations - optimising performance and profitability where decisions show up in production within days, not quarters.

Operating as the highest individual contributor level in Product, you will serve as a recognized domain authority for Product Directors and VPs, with the capability and strategic breadth to step into a Director role. Day to day, you will manage the boundary between what the robot can reliably pick, how orders get planned and packed and what the CFC can execute without losing throughput or delivery quality. You will drive cross-area strategy, influence senior engineering counterparts and collaborate with commercial leaders to accelerate feature adoption and scale OGRP across new global sites.

  • Lead exception design and site readiness, establishing criteria that allow OGRP to launch reliably across diverse global layouts.

  • Drive rigorous experimentation and hypothesis testing, holding cross-functional teams to high standards of evidence and validation.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex business environments and influence organizational strategy at the senior leadership and C-suite level.

  • Strong data and commercial fluency, with the ability to manage P&L impacts, build financial rationales and defend prioritization decisions.

  • Comfort making high-quality, decisive choices under conditions of ambiguity, high operational stakes and physical constraints.

Benefits:

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance.
